compare.title: Who works for you when buying land?
compare.intro: At an estate agency, the mandate usually comes from the owner who sells. At Land Advisors, the consultant works only for you: the buyer. Same word "advisory", different incentives.
compare.note: Wanting a place is natural. We add territorial and local market criteria so that decision holds up — working in your interests as the buyer.

rows.label: Who do they work for?
rows.la: Only for you — the buyer. We protect your objective, budget and decision.
rows.cor: For the owner who sells — and also intermediates with you. Their mandate comes from the supply side.

rows.label: Role
rows.la: A consultant who searches — among contacts, agencies and developers — for the land that best fits your objectives and needs.
rows.cor: A salesperson who prioritises which of their own plots is easiest to sell you.

rows.label: Offer they know
rows.la: Studies the broad territorial offer: owners, agencies and developers.
rows.cor: Knows mainly the land they have for sale.

rows.label: Clients
rows.la: Clients who want to make a smart purchase or a sound investment.
rows.cor: A client willing to choose land with less territorial information.

rows.label: Incentive
rows.la: That you choose land appropriate to your objective, whatever it may be.
rows.cor: Closing the sale of an asset from their stock.

faq.q: Do I have to contract search to get the free diagnostic?
faq.a: No. Strategic Diagnostic is free in this promotion, with no obligation to contract search or any other service.

faq.q: What does the free Strategic Diagnostic include?
faq.a: Strategy session (online or in person), recommended zones for your objective and criteria to evaluate land before offering. Usual value: 1 UF.

faq.q: When does Personalised Search at 3.5 UF apply?
faq.a: Only if after the diagnostic you decide you want us to search with you. We give a clear quote; there is no automatic commitment.

faq.q: Are the 3.5 UF deducted if I buy land?
faq.a: Yes. If you contract our Purchase Advisory (2.5% of value), the 3.5 UF paid for Personalised Search is deducted from that fee.

faq.q: How long is the promotion valid?
faq.a: Free diagnostic and search at 3.5 UF valid for bookings confirmed until 30 September 2026, subject to availability.

faq.q: Do you work with buyers outside the south?
faq.a: Yes. Many clients live in Santiago or northern Chile and buy in the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin. The initial session can be online.
No. Land Advisors is territorial consultancy: we do not sell our own land; we help you buy the right piece with territorial and local market reading.
